name: Gemini Credit Card
summary: The Gemini Credit Card is a US-only, no-annual-fee Mastercard that pays crypto rewards on every purchase — up to 4% on gas and EV charging, 3% on dining and 2% on groceries, paid instantly in Bitcoin or 60+ other coins. Conceptually strong, but it is gated behind a credit check and criticised for low credit limits and slow support.
availabilityNotes: The Gemini Credit Card is available to US residents only, including US territories where supported. It cannot be ordered outside the United States. The card is issued by WebBank.

kyc.notes: Full KYC plus a US credit check. You need a US Social Security number, a US address and a credit profile to be approved. Identity checks are run by Gemini and the card issuer, WebBank.

pros: Up to 4% crypto rewards on gas and EV charging
No annual fee and no foreign transaction fees
Choose rewards in 60+ cryptocurrencies, paid instantly
$200 welcome bonus for eligible new cardholders
Regulated US issuer with a strong compliance record
cons: Requires a credit check and approval
The 4% category is capped at US$300 of spend per month
Variable APR of roughly 17–29% if you carry a balance
No debit or virtual card option

referral.bonus: $50 referral bonus for new cardholders ($200 welcome bonus for eligible applicants)
referral.terms: Bonuses are set by Gemini and depend on approval and qualifying spend. The welcome bonus typically requires meeting a spend threshold within a set period. Confirm the current offer before applying.
referral.eligibility: US residents aged 18+ who apply for the Gemini Credit Card and are approved after a credit check.

howToGet: Confirm you are a US resident with a Social Security number and a US credit profile.
Open the Gemini app or website and start the Gemini Credit Card application.
Complete the credit check and, if approved, finish identity verification.
Use the card for eligible purchases and pick the crypto your rewards are paid in.
Rewards are credited instantly to your Gemini account, where they are held in custody.

faq.question: Who can get the Gemini Credit Card?
faq.answer: US residents only. You need to be 18 or over with a Social Security number, a US address and a credit profile that passes the issuer's credit check. It is not available outside the United States.

faq.question: Does the Gemini Credit Card have an annual fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no annual fee and no foreign transaction fee. The main cost is interest if you carry a balance, with a variable APR of roughly 17–29%.

faq.question: How much cashback does the Gemini Credit Card pay?
faq.answer: Up to 4% on gas and EV charging, 3% on dining, 2% on groceries and 1% on everything else, paid in crypto. The 4% category is capped at US$300 of spend per month, after which it drops to the base rate.

faq.question: Can I choose which crypto my rewards are paid in?
faq.answer: Yes. Rewards can be paid in Bitcoin or 60+ other supported cryptocurrencies, and they are credited to your Gemini account rather than to a self-custody wallet.
